properties.headline: Môreson applies to rezone portions of its property for group housing development
properties.summary: Rezoning/subdivision of RE Erf 7173 (Môreson Child & Youth Care Centre) for 37 group-housing units (2 storeys, 127 bays); land to be sold to a developer to fund the centre. Neighbours object; Nel & De Kock Town Planners act for Môreson.
properties.place: Môreson, Petunia St area (Kat River), George
properties.developer: Môreson (owner) – Nel & De Kock Town Planners; buyer/developer not yet named
properties.map_link: Erf 7173 (same application already on the map)

properties.headline: Forever homes in sight for 61 Hornlee families
properties.summary: Knysna handed over 61 plot-to-plan sites on Erf 3339 (Fisherhaven/Rykmanshoogte/Hornlee); beneficiaries may now draw up building plans, deposits due 1 Oct–31 Dec.

properties.headline: Safe space plan for George's homeless
properties.summary: Working committee (municipality, Cremhog, business chamber, SAPS) prioritises a central low-entry overnight safe space and a first-contact service point; a CID, rehab centre and elderly sub-economic housing are longer-term ideas. No site chosen yet.
properties.developer: Cremhog / George Municipality working committee; possible new NPO or CID

properties.headline: Tyremart Commercial is in town! New name, same trusted team
properties.summary: Tyres & Treads Group rebrands its 22 Pioneer Road branch and says plans are under way for a new Tyremart outlet at the Garden Route Mall.

properties.headline: Eden House: From dream to reality
properties.summary: NPC has raised the full R2.75m to buy a property for Eden House, a planned registered children's home in Knysna; the home still has to be set up.

properties.headline: Concern over impact of multi-storey flats next to Blue Mountain
properties.summary: GRRA public meeting on Century Property Developments' bid to rezone Erf 28005 (5.7ha, Park Rd/Platinum Dr) from Business I to General Residential IV for ±680 rental flats in 18 three-/four-storey blocks; building line moved to 20m; still in public participation.
properties.place: Behind Builders Warehouse, Park Rd / Platinum Dr, George
properties.map_link: Erf 28005 (same application already on the map)

properties.headline: Controversial Building Control By-law repealed
properties.summary: Council repealed the 2023 Building Control By-law (25 Aug); a new by-law will drop minor works from plan approval, add simplified "Category 1" low-income/backyard buildings and align occupancy certificates with the NBR. Public engagement to follow.

properties.headline: George water security under pressure as population grows
properties.summary: No blanket moratorium on major developments, but larger developments must carry enforceable water demand management plans (efficient fittings, metering, rainwater tanks, indigenous landscaping). Treatment capacity now ~60 Ml/day.

properties.headline: Plattner Boulevard's first phase complete, with more upgrades to come
properties.summary: Phase 1 rehabilitation reopened 5 Sep; phase 2 (Barkhuizen Dr–Victor Smith Cres) depends on funding, phase 3 (to York St) needs access/capacity issues solved first.

properties.headline: Council considers impact of labour costs on IUDG-funded projects
properties.summary: Special council (28 Sep) adopted the 2026/27 Consolidated Capital Expenditure Framework that ranks infrastructure priorities for IUDG funding; PA wage proposal debated. Projects still need annual budget approval. (George Herald covered it 29 Sep.)

properties.headline: GO GEORGE activates trial route to airport
properties.summary: Route 19 Airport trial (CBD transport hub to George Airport via MediClinic) started 20 Sep, 05:00–20:00 daily; more stops may follow. (George Herald covered it 22 Sep.)

properties.headline: R26m boost for Garden Route disaster repairs
properties.summary: Municipal Disaster Response Grant: George gets R5m, mainly for the Haarlem Dam–Uniondale main water line; 6 months to spend.
properties.map_link: Related to (not the same as) the Uniondale water-network item (Erf 354)

properties.headline: Drone survey planned for Wilderness Beach as part of coastal dune rehabilitation plan
properties.summary: Baseline drone survey (15 Sep) for a coastal dune rehabilitation and maintenance management plan for part of Wilderness Beach; may affect future beachfront works.

properties.headline: Is Swartvlei for sale?
properties.summary: GRDM plans to sell Portion 0 of Farm 185 (Swartvlei Beach property, expected R15.9m) and RE Erf 1297 Kleinkrantz/Wilderness (R30m, SANParks talks); Save Our Sedgefield is pursuing legal remedies.
properties.erf: Portion 0 of Farm 185; RE Erf 1297 Wilderness

properties.headline: Aalwyndal: Development deadlock
properties.summary: 600ha Aalwyndal urban-expansion area (SDF 2018/2022) is stalled: council deferred the draft biodiversity/offset study; landowners want to be consulted.

properties.headline: Serious structural concerns for current Kwa station
properties.summary: KwaNonqaba police station failed a health inspection; a land exchange (17 Aug) between Mossel Bay Municipality and Public Works is the first step towards a long-awaited new station.
properties.developer: National Department of Public Works / SAPS
